You are a legal research assistant. Produce a concise research brief on the following topic for an attorney's review.

Topic: Enforceability of non-compete agreements for remote software engineers
Jurisdiction: California

Retrieved sources (use these to ground your brief):
[Source 1] Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16600: Every contract by which anyone is restrained from engaging in a lawful profession, trade, or business of any kind is to that extent void.
[Source 2] Edwards v. Arthur Andersen LLP (2008) 44 Cal.4th 937: California courts strictly enforce § 16600 and reject the 'rule of reason' approach.
[Source 3] AMN Healthcare v. Aya Healthcare (2018): Non-solicitation clauses that effectively restrain competition are also void under § 16600.

Structure your brief as follows:
1. Issue — one-sentence statement of the legal question
2. Applicable Law — relevant statutes and key cases (cite sources where provided)
3. Analysis — how the law applies to the topic
4. Conclusion — one-sentence bottom line
